title: CN Tower, Toronto
scope: The exterior of Toronto’s CN Tower: the three concrete buttresses, visible core and elevator tracks, radome, two observation pods, antenna and immediate base.

primaryWrittenSources.title: Science and Technology Understanding Structures and Mechanisms, Grade 7
primaryWrittenSources.author: CN Tower
primaryWrittenSources.facts: Official named height controls: antenna 553.33 m, the Top 447 m, EdgeWalk 356 m, 360 Restaurant 351 m, Main Observation 346 m, Lower Observation 342 m. Written dimensions used; no illustrations adopted.

limitations: This replaces the provisional tower asset in its existing catalog location and covers the tower itself; the aquarium, adjacent SkyWalk, stadia, and interiors are outside scope.
Current plan geometry and the tower operator’s elevations govern the major forms. The exact shape of the transitions, glazing subdivision, plinth details and communications equipment are estimated.
Ground elevation is an unmodified Terrarium sample; individual thresholds and the elevation of the surrounding paved plaza are approximate.
